scenarios.name: status_table
scenarios.pins: ticket-format 5.9 along one ticket: decisions in each state, verdicts and code decisions only in testing, a pass that does not complete the done rule leaves the status, done is sticky, close and reopen

steps.note: the code gate applies
the ticket is filled in one edit
sev reviews (verify approvers: reviewers)
requirements approval in open: status unchanged
plan approval in open
verdicts only in testing
code decisions only in testing
a duplicate approval by the same person is accepted and counts once
verdicts only in testing, not in progress
requirements and plan approved, evidence for every AC, verification written
changes requested on plan while testing: back to in_progress
plan is no longer approved
plan approved again
a failing verdict: testing -> in_progress
a failing verdict raises verify and later gates only: requirements and plan still count
a passing verdict that does not complete the done rule (code is missing): stays testing
the code approval completes the done rule: done
no decisions on a done ticket
done: bound paths are refused from every actor
a watcher on a done ticket changes nothing
a workspace policy change raises generations but done is sticky
close from done
no decisions on a closed ticket
already closed
reopen from closed
reopen from open
